sour: The taste of lemons and vinegar
bitter: The taste of black coffee and dark chocolate
umami: A savory taste named in Japan, the taste of glutamate
bechamel: Milk thickened with a white roux
veloute: Light stock thickened with a blond roux
espagnole: A rich brown sauce, the base of demi-glace
sauce-tomate: The red one, built on tomatoes
hollandaise: Egg yolks and butter emulsified with lemon
onion: The one that makes you cry
